name: dep_graph
description: Import dependency graph of a file (transitive N levels) or the whole project (scope=project → nodes/edges/cycles). Circular deps? fix_imports. Changing a dep? impact_analysis first.

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: project root (abs). reindex first if new.

file.description: File path relative to workspace_dir (e.g. "scripts/lib/tools/spawn.mjs"). Omit or use scope=project for whole-project graph.

scope.description: B13: scope=project → whole-project module graph {nodes, edges, cycles}. Mutually exclusive with file.

depth.description: Transitive depth (default 3, max 10). File mode only.
